paragraphs: Hyman reports that it is cited thus in Otzar Yisrael and should read as in the entry R' Yasa son of R' Shabtai.[^1]

notes.text: Hyman reports the Issi form from Otzar Yisrael and says that it should read as in the entry R' Yasa son of R' Shabtai. Otzar Yisrael has not been freshly collated here. The two source-abbreviated titles remain R', and Issi and Yasa remain distinct supplied forms. This translates Hyman’s correction and cross-reference without adopting an identity equivalence or binding the target.
